name: tstack
short: A set of AI skills for shipping pull requests: review, file, babysit through CI, and merge.
what: tstack is the author's own daily AI skills, cleaned up for anyone to use. You trigger them by saying a phrase like "full send", "file a PR" or "babysit". They cover proving and reviewing a change, filing short PRs, watching CI and review bots, taking over someone else's PR, and getting review from three models from different providers.
who: Developers who already work through GitHub pull requests with a coding agent. Skip it if you don't use GitHub or the `gh` CLI.
needs: For `council` and `sol-loop`: a harness that can run subagents on other providers' models

steps.title: Copy the skills in
steps.text: Use the line for your agent.
steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/t3dotgg/tstack
cp -R tstack/skills/* ~/.claude/skills/   # Claude Code
cp -R tstack/skills/* ~/.codex/skills/    # Codex

steps.title: Keep the ones they depend on
steps.text: Some skills call others. For example, `full-send` uses `sol-loop`, `file-pr` and `babysit-pr`, and most use `leaving-pr-comments`. The README lists each dependency.

steps.title: Make them yours
steps.text: Put personal settings, such as which models sit on your council, in your `CLAUDE.md` or `AGENTS.md`. That way you can update the skills without losing them.

try.label: From the README
try.text: After making a change, say "file a PR" to have it filed with a short description that leads with the problem.

watch: These skills act on GitHub with your `gh` login. `full-send` merges a PR with nobody watching. Use `full-stop` if you want to do the final merge yourself.
`council` and `sol-loop` send your change to models from other providers for review.
